# Matteo Migliarini

> AI Safety Researcher and Software Engineer. Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science at Sapienza University of Rome. Fellow at LASR Labs, London.

Personal site: https://mamiglia.github.io/ (single-page app; the plain-text sources below contain the same content).

## About

- Ph.D. in Computer Science, Sapienza University of Rome, 2024–present. Supervised by Fabio Galasso and Indro Spinelli. Research focus: safety measures for advanced AI systems, robust AI, responsible deployment.
- LASR Labs Fellowship, London, Jul 2026–present. Scalable oversight: evaluating model capability once benchmarks saturate; testing whether model rollouts carry capability signal beyond raw accuracy. Mentored by Magda Dubois (UK AISI) and Justin Olive (Generality Labs).
- ARENA 5.0, London, May 2025. Capstone on a self-suppressing attention head in GPT-2 (Honorable Mention).
- Algoverse AI, Jun–Dec 2025. Mentored a team of 5 from research ideation to publication.
- Accenture, Rome, Sep 2021–Jan 2022. Software engineer on a healthcare data analytics pipeline (SQL, Java/Spring, JS).
- M.Sc. Data Science (2022–2024) and B.Sc. Engineering in Computer Science (2019–2022), Sapienza University of Rome.
- Open source: substantial work on Inspect AI (UK AISI), 20+ PRs and issues across inspect_ai and inspect_evals; occasional contributions to PyTorch.

## Publications

- Quantifying Self-Preservation Bias in Large Language Models. M. Migliarini et al. EMNLP 2026. https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02174
- Video Unlearning via Low-Rank Refusal Vector. S. Facchiano, S. Saravalle, M. Migliarini et al. ICLR 2026. https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.07891
- Human Motion Unlearning. E. De Matteis*, M. Migliarini* et al. AAAI 2026. https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.18674
- @GrokSet: Multi-Party Human-LLM Interactions in Social Media. M. Migliarini et al. 2026. https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.21236
- SeRpEnt: Selective Resampling for Expressive State Space Models. ICML 2024 Workshop on Next Generation of Sequence Modeling. https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.11729
- The Self-Hating Attention Head: A Deep Dive in GPT-2. LessWrong, 2025. https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/wxPvdBwWeaneAsWRB/the-self-hating-attention-head-a-deep-dive-in-gpt-2-1
